full_title: AdaNav: Adaptive Reasoning with Uncertainty for Vision-Language Navigation

bibliography_sources.locator: Primary record and supplied PDF p.1

repository_status: Advertised official repository inaccessible

key_findings.claim: Adaptive entropy-gated reasoning is established prior art, with training and latency ablations.

bottlenecks.description: Confidently wrong or brief ambiguity can escape the reasoning gate
bottlenecks.conditions: Novel semantics, short lighting/view changes, or transient uncertainty
bottlenecks.cause: Action token entropy is not calibrated probability of navigation failure; temporal averaging suppresses spikes
bottlenecks.evidence: Author-acknowledged Appendix F, Table 17; deduction from Eq.5 and entropy averaging
bottlenecks.followups: AwareVLN uses supervised key-event triggers; Progress-Think models semantic progress. Neither establishes calibration of this gate.

access_limitations: The main paper and relevant appendices were reviewed. The advertised official code URL was inaccessible at the cutoff; no implementation or benchmark was executed.
completion_status: Paper review and scoped source audit complete; access and reproduction limits documented
